summary: Iteration 2 backend testing of JOBBY new endpoints (categories, wallet, payments, requests, chat) + Modello D on ANY category + 401 guards. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_jobby_new_endpoints.py — 21/21 pytests passed against the public preview URL. Categories return 9 items with correct badges (prossimita=7, pagamenti=4), subcategory GETs include parent + parent_type. Wallet defaults 92.29, top-up creates transaction. Payments deduct wallet + create service_request + return 400 insufficient_funds when amount>balance. Requests aggregates {payments,missions}. Chat auto-creates conversation from booking, sends messages, returns 404 on unknown convo. Modello D bots auto-accept for 'babysitting' and 'tecnico' (invited regardless of services array — bots included via is_bot exception in create_mission).

minor.issue: No validation that service_id belongs to a real payment subcategory or that amount > 0; a client can post amount=0 or negative to log a fake request. Consider validating body.amount > 0 and body.service_id in payment subcategory ids.
No validation that amount > 0; a negative amount would silently reduce the wallet balance and create a mislabeled 'topup' transaction. Add amount > 0 guard.
No ownership check — any authenticated user can read any conversation's messages by guessing/knowing the id. Should verify convo.user_id == current user.
No ownership check — any authenticated user could inject messages into another user's conversation.
Existing issue from iter 1: no check that caller is the mission's customer.

action_items: Add server-side validation: amount>0 on /wallet/add and /payments (currently silently accepts negative/zero).
Add ownership checks on GET/POST /chat/{conversation_id} (verify convo.user_id == current user) and /missions/{id}/select.
Optional: validate service_id in /payments is one of the pagamenti subcategory ids.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~720 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, missions, bookings, wallet, chat, categories) before adding more features.

create_mission now invites bots via `if not p.get('is_bot') and body.category not in p.get('services', [])` — bots match ANY category as intended. Real (non-bot) providers still require category in services array. Behavior is correct per spec but worth documenting.
get_categories returns a shallow-copy dict from the CATEGORIES module constant and mutates it with a `badge` key on each call — safe here but if you later cache or memoize, wrap with deepcopy.
ensure_conversation is only auto-invoked by GET /chat/conversations; there's no way for a provider to initiate a chat before a booking exists. Fine for MVP.
Deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event still used (noted in iter 1 too).

success_rate.frontend: not tested (per request — Google OAuth cannot be automated)

seed_data_creation: Each test inserts a synthetic TEST_ user + user_sessions doc directly into MongoDB (test_database) to obtain a Bearer token, then cleans up users/sessions/transactions/service_requests/missions/bookings/conversations/messages after the test. Bot providers seeded by server startup are reused as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Auth = Emergent Google OAuth; for protected endpoints insert users + user_sessions directly in Mongo (see _mk_user helper in test_jobby_new_endpoints.py). Bot auto-accept: create_mission spawns asyncio.create_task with random 2-9s delay per invited bot — poll GET /missions/{id} up to 15s for accepted[]. Wallet default balance for new users = 92.29. Payment amount deducts from user.wallet_balance and inserts a negative-amount transaction (type=payment) + a service_requests doc (kind=payment, status=completed). Categories endpoint returns 9 items: 7 service + prossimita (7 subs, badge=7) + pagamenti (4 subs, badge=4). Subcategory GET returns {...sub, parent, parent_type}. All new endpoints require Bearer token (401 without).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all iter-2 tests green. Only code-review remarks for hardening: missing amount>0 validation on /wallet/add and /payments, and missing ownership checks on /chat/{id} GET/POST and /missions/{id}/select. Not blocking MVP but should be addressed before real users.
